headline: Genki’s new customizable controller has a big screen and adjustable buttons
summary: Genki launched the Manta, a new customizable controller with an unorthodox design. It features a large 2.9-inch LCD screen positioned above thumbsticks and buttons. The controller offers adjustable controls for personalized gameplay.

headline: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
summary: Google Discover will soon allow users to customize their feed using AI. The new feature lets you describe desired content, and AI will adapt the feed. It will remember your preferences for future visits, rolling out soon.

headline: Riot is ending development on its League of Legends fighting game
summary: Riot Games is winding down active development on its League of Legends fighting game, 2XKO. The company states it hasn't seen enough player retention for sustainability. Development will conclude by the end of 2026.

headline: The Genesis GV90 blows the bloody doors off what’s possible in EV design
summary: Genesis unveiled its first full-size, three-row electric SUV for the US market, the GV90. The GV90 boasts a wild design with distinctive coach-style doors. It promises to set new standards in EV design and luxury features.

headline: Ms Marvel Star Returns to MCU With Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
summary: Ms. Marvel star Iman Vellani will host the official 'Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday' podcast. This marks her return to the MCU in a new capacity. The podcast will build anticipation for the upcoming Avengers movie.

headline: Lanterns Saw the Biggest Premiere for a DC Studios Show on HBO Max, Ahead of The Penguin and Peacemaker
summary: 'Lanterns' achieved the biggest premiere for a DC Studios show on HBO Max. Its debut surpassed previous strong performers like 'The Penguin' and 'Peacemaker'. The series got off to a highly successful start on the platform.

headline: Netflix Reveals New Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Trailer and Images at Anime NYC
summary: Netflix unveiled a new trailer and images for 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2' at Anime NYC. The reveal offered a closer look at the upcoming series' high-octane action. Fans can anticipate more of Night City's tragic and intense story.

headline: Netflix Confirms Blue Eye Samurai Will End With Third and Final Season
summary: Netflix has confirmed that its critically acclaimed series 'Blue Eye Samurai' will conclude. The show will end after its upcoming third and final season. Fans can prepare for the epic conclusion of the animated saga.

headline: El Niño warming set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
summary: The Met Office warns of an El Niño warming event set to be the 'strongest in living memory'. Scientists predict this unprecedented event will significantly raise global temperatures in 2027. The UK faces a risk of a wetter, stormier autumn as a result.

headline: Meghan could return to acting once back in UK
summary: Reports suggest Meghan Markle may return to acting if she moves back to the UK. Sources close to the Sussexes have not denied claims of acting offers. A potential move could open new professional opportunities for her.

headline: My life was changed by a terror attack - now survivors like me won't be forgotten
summary: The UK is marking its first national day for victims and survivors of terrorism. This day aims to ensure those affected by terror attacks are remembered and supported. A survivor shares his powerful story, highlighting the day's significance.

headline: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
summary: Israel has re-established a previously closed West Bank settlement, defying international protests. Thirty 'pioneer families' have moved in, driven by a wave of nationalism. This rapid change has sparked fear among nearby Palestinian residents.
